Train. Recover. Restore. Unwind.

Serene is a fitness and wellness club in Mansarovar, Jaipur. Strength training, a dedicated Pilates studio and recovery sit under one roof, in rooms shaped by arched windows, warm wood and plenty of daylight.

Plan your visit

Four ways to spend your time here.

Everything at Serene comes back to four words. Open one to see the spaces behind it.

  • A training floor lined with arched mirrors and windows, free weights by the glass, and a dedicated Pilates studio with reformers and towers.

    • Training floor
    • Free weights
    • Studio floor
    • Pilates studio

  • Red-light therapy and heat, so the work you put in on the floor has somewhere to settle.

    • Red-light therapy
    • Sauna

  • Slower sessions for mobility, breath and balance, on the mat or on the reformer.

    • Mobility
    • Mat work
    • Reformer Pilates

  • Slow down by the water or over a matcha before heading back into the city.

    • Poolside
    • Matcha

The main training floor

Why Serene.

Built around daylight.

Tall arched windows run along the training floor and let the daylight in, so sessions feel open rather than boxed in.

Training and recovery, in one place.

Strength, Pilates, red light and heat share one address, which makes recovery part of the routine instead of an afterthought.

A room just for Pilates.

Reformers and towers have their own curtained studio with back-lit arched mirrors, separate from the main floor.

Membership by invitation.
